prompt: From the first frame the camera pushes in slowly and smoothly toward the carved wooden sign, keeping it centred. Around it, the big banana leaves in the foreground rock gently in a breeze and the bamboo behind sways. Dappled sunlight slides across the wood, spots of light drifting over the grain. The sign and its bamboo frame stay fixed and solid; the white lettering stays sharp and identical: DETOX FROM MATERIALISM, WEEKEND RETREAT, £3,000. Quiet jungle morning, real footage.
